label: secure-context-null-key
sql: SELECT SECURE_CONTEXT(CAST(NULL AS STRING)) AS value

label: secure-context-cast-corrected
sql: SELECT CAST(SECURE_CONTEXT('user_id') AS INT64) AS value

label: secure-context-query-param-separate
sql: SELECT SECURE_CONTEXT('user_id') AS value, @user_id AS ordinary_param

label: zstd-null-level
sql: SELECT ZSTD_COMPRESS('hello', CAST(NULL AS INT64)) IS NULL AS is_null

label: zstd_decompress_to_bytes-null-limit
sql: SELECT ZSTD_DECOMPRESS_TO_BYTES(ZSTD_COMPRESS('hello'), size_limit=>CAST(NULL AS INT64)) IS NULL AS is_null

label: zstd_decompress_to_string-null-limit
sql: SELECT ZSTD_DECOMPRESS_TO_STRING(ZSTD_COMPRESS('hello'), size_limit=>CAST(NULL AS INT64)) IS NULL AS is_null

label: distribution-agg-empty-struct
sql: SELECT SPANNER_SYS.DISTRIBUTION_AGG(LATENCY_DISTRIBUTION[SAFE_OFFSET(0)]) AS value FROM SPANNER_SYS.QUERY_STATS_TOP_MINUTE WHERE FALSE

label: distribution-agg-empty-json
sql: SELECT SPANNER_SYS.DISTRIBUTION_AGG(LATENCY_DISTRIBUTION_JSON_STRING) AS value FROM SPANNER_SYS.QUERY_STATS_TOP_MINUTE WHERE FALSE

label: distribution-agg-documented-query-struct
sql: SELECT IF(latency_dist IS NOT NULL, SPANNER_SYS.DISTRIBUTION_PERCENTILE(latency_dist, 99.0), NULL) AS p99 FROM (SELECT SPANNER_SYS.DISTRIBUTION_AGG(IF(T.LATENCY_DISTRIBUTION[SAFE_OFFSET(0)].COUNT > 0, T.LATENCY_DISTRIBUTION[SAFE_OFFSET(0)], NULL)) AS latency_dist FROM SPANNER_SYS.QUERY_STATS_TOP_MINUTE AS T WHERE T.INTERVAL_END > TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 1 HOUR) AND T.INTERVAL_END <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP())

label: distribution-agg-documented-txn-struct
sql: WITH aggregated_stats AS (SELECT T.FPRINT, SPANNER_SYS.DISTRIBUTION_AGG(IF(T.COMMIT_LATENCY_DISTRIBUTION[SAFE_OFFSET(0)].COUNT > 0, T.COMMIT_LATENCY_DISTRIBUTION[SAFE_OFFSET(0)], NULL)) AS commit_latency_dist FROM SPANNER_SYS.TXN_STATS_TOP_MINUTE AS T WHERE T.INTERVAL_END > TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 1 HOUR) AND T.INTERVAL_END <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() GROUP BY T.FPRINT) SELECT FPRINT, IF(commit_latency_dist IS NOT NULL, SPANNER_SYS.DISTRIBUTION_PERCENTILE(commit_latency_dist, 99.0), NULL) AS p99 FROM aggregated_stats

label: distribution-agg-query-json
sql: SELECT SPANNER_SYS.DISTRIBUTION_PERCENTILE(SPANNER_SYS.DISTRIBUTION_AGG(LATENCY_DISTRIBUTION_JSON_STRING), 99.0) AS p99 FROM SPANNER_SYS.QUERY_STATS_TOP_MINUTE WHERE INTERVAL_END > TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 1 HOUR)

label: distribution-agg-array-negative
sql: SELECT SPANNER_SYS.DISTRIBUTION_AGG(LATENCY_DISTRIBUTION) AS value FROM SPANNER_SYS.QUERY_STATS_TOP_MINUTE WHERE FALSE
